exposure: history of previous neuraxial anaesthesia for caesarean delivery
cohort: Patients aged 18 years or older undergoing non-elective Caesarean delivery under spinal anaesthesia in a university teaching hospital.
finding: High preoperative anxiety is an independent risk factor for post-spinal shivering during non-elective Caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: High preoperative anxiety is an independent risk factor for post-spinal shivering during non-elective Caesarean delivery, while a history of previous neuraxial anaesthesia for prior CD is protective.
